items.title: Notify users when new assets are added or updated
items.problem: A client could not tell which assets had been added or updated, and received no notification.
items.expected: Users can see an unread or recent indicator and optionally receive an in-app or email notification for new and updated assets.
items.evidence: Direct client feedback reported by Matt on October 4, 2026.
items.proposed: Add per-workspace asset activity, unread state, notification preferences, and a recent changes view.

items.title: Uploaded MOV videos can fail AI indexing with a generic error
items.problem: Uploaded MOV files appeared in AI Indexing but failed with a generic processing error.
items.expected: Supported videos index successfully or return a specific codec, size, queue, or processing error with retry guidance.
items.proposed: Expose stage-specific failure codes, supported-format guidance, and a safe retry action.

items.title: No bulk select and bulk re-index action for media
items.problem: Operators cannot select multiple files or videos and trigger indexing or re-indexing as one recovery action.
items.expected: Bulk select supports index, re-index, and clear progress or failure reporting.
items.proposed: Add multi-select action bar, batch job state, partial-failure detail, and retry failed only.

items.title: Project priority can render as None or Undefined
items.problem: Priority values have rendered as raw None or Undefined in different project views.
items.expected: A saved priority renders consistently; an empty priority uses a clear human label.
items.evidence: Existing Soontra QA records across list and Kanban views.
items.proposed: Unify priority serialization and empty-state rendering across views.

items.title: Close the content-memory learning loop
items.workflow: Footage to draft to approval to performance learning
items.problem: Content memory, visual moments, approvals, publishing status, and performance are not yet proven as one automatic loop.
items.expected: Soontra understands raw footage, retrieves exact moments, drafts channel variants, remembers approvals, and learns from outcome data while Vista handles unsupported publishing work.
items.evidence: Matt's target operating model from October 4, 2026.
items.proposed: Pilot one Creator Club workflow and instrument every handoff before broad automation.
